description: This file defines the SubSetMatcher class, which contains static methods for checking if a subset of entries is contained within a superset, using regex matching and handling optional and negated entries.

classes.name: SubSetMatcher
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to check subset containment with regex matching, considering optional and negated entries.

methods.name: containsSubset
methods.description: Checks if the subset list is contained within the superset list, considering optional and negated entries, using regex matching.

methods.name: matchesIndexes
methods.description: Finds indexes in the matched list where both key and value match the given matcher item using regex.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if any item in the list matches the given matcher item's key using regex.

methods.name: nottedAndPresent
methods.description: Determines if a negated key in the matcher is present in the list.
